answer: No. All cited complaints and the luggage-capacity study are from EU sources: repeated EU feedback describes reduced boot space (hybrid battery), missing tie‑downs and internal shut button, and unreliable key/keyless tailgate operation; the EU study reports mean luggage capacity 7.1. There is no US evidence presented, so this is not a US‑only issue — it appears to be an EU problem that must be addressed globally or per‑market.
suggested_change: Allow documented exceptions for hybrid/EV variants where packaging makes the luggage requirement infeasible, but require: (a) mandatory internal boot‑shut control and luggage tie‑downs on all variants, (b) clear customer communication at point of sale when volume is reduced, and (c) per‑variant measurement of the durability/fault criteria with remedial measures if targets are missed.
